# EventfulRanges

> A CRDT for real-valued ranges and n-dimensional regions in C# on .NET 10: replicas add and remove them, exchange operations, and converge to the same set in any arrival order.

Package `EventfulRanges` and `EventfulRanges.Kurrent` · namespace `EventfulRanges` · target `net10.0` · license MPL-2.0 · published `0.1.0`: the whole library — the range half, the n-dimensional half (boxes, box strategies, `BoxEngine`, `BoxSet`, `RTree`), snapshots and compaction, and the KurrentDB store.

## Reference (exact specs)

- [API reference](docs/users/reference/api.md): every public type, signature, default, exception and invariant.
- [Release pipeline](docs/developers/reference/release-pipeline.md): tags, permissions, feeds, required nuget.org policy fields.
